use default
use System.Random

riffle_shuffle(deck: LIST[int], random: Random) -> LIST[int] is
    let half = deck.count / 2
    let left = LIST[int](deck[0..half])
    let right = LIST[int](deck[half..<0])
    let merged = LIST[int]()

    while left.count > 0 /\ right.count > 0 do
        if random.next(0, left.count + right.count) < left.count then
            merged.add(left[0])
            left.remove_at(0)
        else
            merged.add(right[0])
            right.remove_at(0)
        fi
    od

    merged.add_range(left)
    merged.add_range(right)

    merged
si

overhand_shuffle(deck: LIST[int], random: Random) -> LIST[int] is
    let remaining = LIST[int](deck)
    let stacked = LIST[int]()

    while remaining.count > 0 do
        let wanted = random.next(1, cast(remaining.count / 5) + 2)
        let group = if wanted < remaining.count then wanted else remaining.count fi
        let taken = LIST[int](remaining[0..group])

        taken.add_range(stacked)
        stacked.clear()
        stacked.add_range(taken)

        remaining.remove_range(0, group)
    od

    stacked
si

let random = Random(42)
let deck = LIST[int]((0..10) |> collect_array())

let riffled = riffle_shuffle(deck, random)
let overhanded = overhand_shuffle(riffled, random)

write_line(riffled |> map(v => "{v}") |> join(" "))
write_line(overhanded |> map(v => "{v}") |> join(" "))
